role: CI gate (ci.yml thread-sanitizer job when inputs.scope != 'gates'; make thread-sanitizer) that runs the EmuquTests unit target under Thread Sanitizer and fails on any TSan warning or test failure.
toplevel: set -euo pipefail; sources lib/preflight.sh (no cd to repo root; relies on cwd). DESTINATION defaults to select_simulator_destination.sh output. gate_mktemp log (exit on failure). Runs `xcodebuild test -enableThreadSanitizer YES -only-testing:EmuquTests` into the log with set +e; gate_require_nonempty on the log (empty -> exit 70). Counts 'WARNING: ThreadSanitizer', "' passed", "' failed" lines. races>0 -> prints 20 lines after each warning, exit 1. status != 0: if failed>0 prints first 20 failed lines; else greps build-error markers (both greps `|| true`, so no match or SIGPIPE cannot end the script) and tails 40 log lines; exits with xcodebuild's status. Else appends summary.
